scientist_policy.authority: Scientist answers relayed by the user, plus explicit user answer on empty section-bins
scientist_policy.exact_user_confirmation: Average all three, treating empty section-bins as zero; label coverage as uncertain
scientist_policy.comparison: Running mean minus Homecage mean, separately for HK1 and PFKP
scientist_policy.alignment: Reuse the previous fixed transforms, without fitting
scientist_policy.anatomy: User relays scientist confirmation of comparable anatomical regions and sufficient previous alignment for the current exploratory comparison
scientist_policy.display_domain: Per-arm union of observed PLA/ChAT bins across all six sections; blank outside that union
